================================================================================
cpath explicit declaration modifiers retain arguments
================================================================================
__declspec(deprecated("message") noinline) int choose(int n) { return n ? 1 : 0; }
struct __declspec(align(16)) Aligned { __declspec(property(get = read, put = write)) int value; };
_declspec(noinline) int legacy();
__declspec() int empty();

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (ms_declspec_modifier
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content)))
      (identifier))
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (conditional_expression
          (identifier)
          (number_literal)
          (number_literal)))))
  (struct_specifier
    (ms_declspec_modifier
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (number_literal)))
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (ms_declspec_modifier
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (assignment_expression
              (identifier)
              (identifier))
            (assignment_expression
              (identifier)
              (identifier))))
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier))))
  (declaration
    (ms_declspec_modifier
      (identifier))
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list)))
  (declaration
    (ms_declspec_modifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))))
